definitions.verified_now: Traceable to working marketing-repository code or approved evidence within the stated scope.
definitions.in_development: Under development; availability, completeness and suitability are not implied.
definitions.planned_for_evaluation: A research or pilot pathway being prepared; approval, completion and findings are not implied.
